description: Phase 2 follow-up (#27): tests, test support and packaging inputs Phase 3 needs. Byte for byte spares4repairs@13b7a50. tools/migration tests re-check every hash.
deployScripts: The four deploy.sh files are packaging references only. They also make AWS changes (services/part-finder/deploy.sh writes inline policies to the S4R server role). Never run them; Phase 3 reproduces the packaging steps.
offlineRun: Sandbox: this repository plus these files, vitest 3.2.7 and @aws-sdk 3.1091.0 (the monorepo pins), Python requirements from the two images plus pytest, fake AWS credentials, no proxy. Tests that fail also fail identically on a full 13b7a50 checkout.
